+title: 'Model: ConnectionModel session factory — newSession, resumeSession, open sessions, close'
+---
+## What
+Add the session factory to `ConnectionModel` in `Sources/FoundationModelsACPClient/Model/ConnectionModel+Sessions.swift`.
+
+- [ ] `public private(set) var openSessions: [SessionId: SessionModel]`.
+- [ ] `newSession(_ request: NewSessionRequest) async throws -> SessionModel`: send the request unchanged; as soon as the response is decoded, call `connection.updates(for:)` (the first subscriber drains the router buffer), read the overflow mark, `attach`, `seed` from the response (`availableCommands`, `configOptions`, ...), store it in `openSessions`, give the model the request sender.
+- [ ] `resumeSession(_ request: ResumeSessionRequest) async throws -> SessionModel`: requires `canResumeSessions`. Make the model and subscribe BEFORE the request is sent (the id is known), `beginReplay()`, send, then `endReplay(response:)` and `seed`. On failure: end the replay, remove the model, rethrow. A resume for an id that is already open reuses that model (state the rule in a doc comment; ask agentviewkit-a3 if they need a fresh model instead).
+- [ ] `close(_ session: SessionModel) async throws`: requires the close capability; sends `session/close`, removes it from `openSessions`, clears its buffer (the router does it on session/close; confirm), `markClosed()`. The model stays readable.
+- [ ] `session(for id:) -> SessionModel?`.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] Updates that the agent sends between its `session/new` response and the attach are in the model (none lost).
+- [ ] A resume replay goes into the model while `isReplaying == true`, and the router buffer is not used.
+- [ ] After `close`, the model has `isClosed == true` and is not in `openSessions`.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] New `Tests/FoundationModelsACPClientTests/Model/ConnectionModelSessionTests.swift` over `InMemoryTransport.pair()` with `ScriptedStubAgent`: an agent that sends updates before its new-session response returns; a resume with a replay; a failed resume; close; resume of an unsupported agent throws and sends nothing.
+- [ ] `swift test --filter ConnectionModelSessionTests` passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
